description: ADDITIVE per-root presentation theme for gen.measurement.mensuration dimensioned figures (rectangles, L-shaped composites, triangles). It REUSES the approved cartesian-theme: the same cx-figure root isolation, the same per-root-variable + one-common-ruleset model, and the same presentationSvg()/exportSvg() materialised-export contract — the coordinate-lines v1.0.2 visual contract is NOT modified, and it does NOT depend on data-chart-theme. It ADDS dimension-rendering primitives (shape fill/edge, dimension + extension lines, arrowheads, right-angle + perpendicular-height markers, measurement labels, the unknown-side marker, the NOT-TO-SCALE banner, the decomposition cut line, and the answer-key result/overlay labels) as new --cx-* variables plus one additive common ruleset. Colour never carries meaning alone: the unknown side is the text '?', the NOT-TO-SCALE banner is text, the decomposition cut is dashed, dimension lines are offset with arrowheads, and the monochrome 'print' mode is the colour-free authoritative rendering.
